input_ancestry.ancestry: Seven inputs select seven coefficients: p,n,pi+,axial magnitude,deuteron binding,neutral-vector and Delta conventions. Js and the positive pair-triplet coefficient are additional calibrated current interactions. The spin-gradient5/2 and other fixed coefficients are inherited architecture choices. These agreements are fits, not independent predictions.
input_ancestry.fit_recipe: For each Js,eta choose D=8U/3-4A/9 to match the actual native axial current; choose A,mbar,delta to fit p,n,pi+. Solve Js,eta against the genuine S=I=3/2 Q1 Delta level and S1I0 even nuclear binding. Choose pair_triplet from the Q0 spin1 meson gap. Freeze the displayed rational coefficients, then independently certify their outputs.
